title: Peritus · choose the instrument
question: Conversation-first, with full physical theater. Both directions honor your industrial control-panel brief.

options.label: The instrument rack
options.thesis: Every project is a powered instrument; nested sessions are channels in the same chassis.
options.viewport: A project rail crowns a broad conversation display, with a file drawer on the left and a narrow control bank on the right.
options.risk: Heavy framing can steal space; the display must remain generous.

raised.raise: Parallel activity remains tied to its exact channel.
Completion feedback has one unmistakable physical snap.
Project, repository, and execution depth remain separately labeled.
Panels collapse with continuous spatial correspondence.
Every operation has a direct command address.
Layered tabs settle with mass, while text stays stationary.

options.label: The machine pendant
options.thesis: Conversation fills one large machine screen, with mode selectors and a persistent side keypad.
options.viewport: A large conversation screen sits inside a substantial frame, with sessions in a left hierarchy and controls along the bottom.
options.risk: The most literal industrial translation; familiar and effective, but less distinctive.

options.label: Labanotation score
options.thesis: Parallel tasks follow a timed vertical score.
options.viewport: Conversation and activity align around a vertical time axis.
options.risk: Upward reading and symbol grammar slow ordinary conversation.
options.case: Lower audience identification and product clarity than the rack.

options.label: Telop caption field
options.thesis: Activity is emphasized with live caption beats.
options.viewport: Replies and status sit in a freely composed live frame.
options.risk: Emphasis competes with long-form code and prose.
options.case: Lower audience identification and product clarity for sustained work.

options.label: Dive profile
options.thesis: Nested project context is navigated as operational depth.
options.viewport: Projects descend into sessions and their execution details.
options.risk: Depth competes with the requested horizontal tab hierarchy.
options.case: Lower audience identification and product clarity for coding sessions.

options.label: Drawcord structure
options.thesis: The workspace reshapes through connected panel folds.
options.viewport: Pulling a panel changes the surrounding workspace continuously.
options.risk: A radial topology conflicts with tabbed file workflows.
options.case: Lower audience identification and product clarity than the rack.

options.label: Teletext service
options.thesis: All functions are directly addressable pages.
options.viewport: A numbered directory routes into held session pages.
options.risk: A fixed cell grid restricts code and multimedia viewing.
options.case: Lower audience identification and product clarity for simultaneous projects.

options.label: Exposure record
options.viewport: Sheets slide aside to expose related session observations.
options.risk: Overlapping content makes simultaneous context harder to read.
options.case: Lower audience identification and product clarity than channel tabs.
options.kept: Weight and settling in layered navigation.
